text:
Aisha (AE): Quick sync — Meridian Health POC. They want SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning for ~15k users, RBAC mappings, domain proofing, and explicit EU data residency. Also asked for a POC price comparison (hosted vs dedicated) and security questionnaire turnaround. Can we confirm what we can promise for a 3-month POC?
Carlos (SE): Quick notes: SAML metadata exchange + IdP cert rollover supported. SCIM v2 push supported, groups + role mapping supported but nested-group behavior is flattened. For initial sync of 15k users we recommend delta sync after an initial bulk import. Need to confirm SCIM rate limits for the customer (we can raise for Dedicated).
Priya (SRE): For Dedicated we'll need an onboarding window to provision VPC + KMS and EU region placement. Hosted POC is feasible if customer is OK with Redwood-managed infra in eu-west-1. For on-prem/private we have longer lead time.
Liam (Security): Send the SQ over — I'll triage. On SAML assertions we require email, sub (uid), and groups claims. SCIM must be HTTPS; mutual TLS is not required but can be accommodated for Private installs. For Hosted we use bearer tokens for SCIM and rotation via our Console.
Aisha (AE): Customer specifically asked about RBAC: "Can we map Okta groups to product roles and have monthly sync?" Also they want domain verification automated for user email claims.
Carlos (SE): Yes — mapping is claim-based + SCIM role assignment. Monthly sync is just a scheduled SCIM sync. Edge case: Okta nested groups — we flatten them during mapping. Example claim config: ```
{
  "mapping": {
    "groups_claim": "groups",
    "role_map": {"meridian-admins": "admin", "meridian-users": "user"}
  }
}
```
Priya (SRE): Ops note: For a 15k initial import on Hosted expect a short window with elevated throughput; we can schedule a one-time bulk job. If they need <24h cutover we should do Dedicated.
Aisha (AE): Pricing ask: they want a POC quote for 3 months. Any ballpark numbers we can throw? They prefer committed pricing if it lowers the operational risk.
Carlos (SE): Ballpark options: Hosted POC: usage-based (tokens/embeddings) + $3k/mo POC support retainer. Dedicated POC: reserved capacity (min 2x A100-equivalent) ~ $24k/mo + onboarding; we can offer 3-month term with a 15-25% intro discount and waive standard onboarding fee for close. Recommend we propose: Hosted trial with $5k credit OR Dedicated 3-month discounted commit with SLA.
Liam (Security): If they require SOC2/HIPAA appendix or DPA tweaks, that affects timeline + legal. Add buffer in proposal. I can draft security addendum text after SQ.
Aisha (AE): Action items: 1) Carlos prepare SAML/SCIM config doc + sample claim mapping (due EOD tomorrow). 2) Priya spin up demo Hosted env in eu-west-1 for smoke tests (ETA 48h). 3) Liam start SQ review and list any gating requirements. 4) I'll draft pricing options and send initial proposal to Meridian.
Priya (SRE): I'll create the demo env and drop creds in #secure-shared when ready. Will also include SCIM rate limit bump option for the POC.
Carlos (SE): I'll attach a short runbook for IdP metadata exchange and example curl for SCIM user push: ```curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.example/scim/v2/Users" -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"userName":"jdoe@example.com","name":{"givenName":"John","familyName":"Doe"}}'```
ops-bot: deployment: demo-hosted-eu started by Priya (SRE) — build #202 -> health checks passing :white_check_mark:
Aisha (AE): Timeline: need to get SQ back to them by Fri to keep sales cadence. Can everyone confirm they can hit their items?
Carlos (SE): Confirmed — I'll have docs and sample mapping by EOD tomorrow.
Priya (SRE): Confirmed — env ETA 48h.
Liam (Security): Confirmed — I'll aim to return an annotated SQ within 72h unless legal needs to weigh in.
Aisha (AE): Great — I'll assemble and send an email proposal after we have Carlos' config and the env link. Will keep this thread for clarifications. :thumbsup:
